usage: xo doc [--json] [--all] [--dir=<dir>] [module dir or import path]
       xo doc [--dir=DIR] [--json|--text] NAME

Markdown documentation from doc comments and signatures, with the
example code blocks of each doc comment. --all includes declarations
that are not pub. Default: the modules under .

With a NAME that is not a directory or an import path (`Map`,
`std/tls.client`), the declaration's doc comment and, for a type, its
methods, as xo def finds it.

A directory means that directory alone; DIR/... covers the directories
below it too, up to 6,000 .xo files or 60,000 entries (decision 0345).
A DIR/... with no .xo file at or below DIR is an error.
